question: What is the purpose of the Radio Network Information Service (RNIS) offered by MEC (Multi-access Edge Computing)?
options: To provide actual RAN information relating to the User Equipments (UEs) in the network
To estimate the location of vehicles and pedestrians
To trigger user-specific traffic rules on the MEC platform
To reserve networking resources at the host
To provide predictions on the Quality-of-Service (QoS) performance of the V2I link
correct_answer: To provide actual RAN information relating to the User Equipments (UEs) in the network

question: What happens during session termination in online charging? [3GPP Release 18]
options: The resource usage is debited from the subscriber account immediately
The network element sends an interim charging event
A certain amount of units is blocked on the subscriber's account
The CDF produces a matching CDR
The value of unused quota is returned to the subscriber's account
correct_answer: The value of unused quota is returned to the subscriber's account

question: How does an AP set up the protection for the duration of the sectorized beam transmission in an SO frame exchange sequence? [IEEE 802.11]
options: By transmitting an ACK or Response frame after the omnidirectional beam transmission.
By setting the NAV for the duration of the sectorized beam transmission.
By transmitting a BF duration frame after the omnidirectional beam transmission.
By switching to the sectorized beam transmission after the omnidirectional preamble.
By transmitting a NAV protected frame after the omnidirectional beam transmission.
correct_answer: By switching to the sectorized beam transmission after the omnidirectional preamble.

question: Can any party in a multiparty call undergo voice call continuity? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Yes, any party in a multiparty call can undergo voice call continuity
No, only the calling party can undergo voice call continuity
No, only the called party can undergo voice call continuity
No, voice call continuity is not supported for multiparty calls
correct_answer: Yes, any party in a multiparty call can undergo voice call continuity

options: PC5 radio resource control
Advanced V2X services
SDAP layer enhancements
V2X communication over NR PC5 reference point

question: What does the Omni field indicate? [IEEE 802.11]
options: The Omni field indicates the type of sectorization operation.
The Omni field indicates if the present transmission is sectorized or omnidirectional.
The Omni field indicates the duration of the current sector transmissions.
The Omni field indicates the ID of the active sector.
The Omni field is reserved when sectorization is activated.
correct_answer: The Omni field indicates if the present transmission is sectorized or omnidirectional.

question: What criteria are considered for network broadcast geographic area coverage management? [3GPP Release 18]
options: OTT provider request and available network capacity
OTT provider request and number of users under broadcast network coverage
Location information of UE and number of users under broadcast network coverage
OTT provider request and location information of UE
Number of users under broadcast network coverage and available network capacity
correct_answer: OTT provider request and number of users under broadcast network coverage

question: What does the 5G system need to provide for mobile base station relays using 5G connectivity provided by a different MNO? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Separate network infrastructure for MNO-B to communicate with MNO-A through the relay
Specific QoS handling for traffic relayed through the MNO-B's network
Ability for MNO-A and MNO-B to share relay resources for UEs connected to the 5G network
Authorization from MNO-A for MNO-B to provide 5G connectivity through the relay
Ownership and control of the relay by MNO-A despite using connectivity from MNO-B
